name: single-block-range
spec: op-private-interop/docs/DESIGN.md: the claim is an ordinary L2 transaction, and it leads the range it describes.
description: firstBlock == lastBlock. A legal, one-block range: the range bound is inclusive on both ends, so this covers one block and not zero. Pins the boundary that separates the valid degenerate case from the inverted-range refusal.
